items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: you can put the stem in and you can sound like some of the Duke Ellington trumpet sections

ctx.x: I’d like to hear what they do.

Well the mutes, okay, I love working with mutes because it can change the texture of what you’re playing. All right open horn. [audio] Make it ring, all right, okay. So then you take a Harmon mute and you take the stem out and you get close to the microphone and you approximately what Miles [audio] or you can put the stem in and you can sound like some of the Duke Ellington trumpet sections. [audio] really an intense, black, Harlem feel. [audio] the wa-wa, okay. And then you have the good old plunger, which of…
Available at your local hardware store, right?
